title: Send the first Play review with Managed publishing on and Data safety set to no data collected
context: With App content clear and the Alpha 1.0.1 draft saved, Publishing overview held 15 changes with Managed publishing off, and Data safety still declared sync's User IDs, Device IDs and invite-code accounts. The owner answered on 2026-10-12.
options: Turn Managed publishing on before sending
Keep the sync-era Data safety answers
Simplify Data safety to no data collected
option_reasons: Chosen: approved changes wait for the owner's Publish click, matching their wish not to publish the closed testing release unprompted
Not chosen: approval would publish the Alpha rollout and listing at once
Not chosen by the owner, though true for Play copies that joined sync before 1.0.1

Chosen by the owner: matches a fresh Play 1.0.1 install, which sends no user data; understates what an already-joined Play copy sends until the sync-engine gap (risk 01M4S857ASR4SP1JZ00B95Z2SR) is fixed
outcome: Done 2026-10-12: Managed publishing on; Data safety saved as collects or shares no required data (preview: No data collection declared, No data shared, privacy policy link), Play said Change saved; Submit 15 changes for review confirmed, and Publishing overview shows them under Changes in review, sent to Google once quick checks finish (up to 12 minutes). Google says reviews typically complete within 7 days.
